import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(
    r"\b(?P<target>TMP|a|b)\s*<-\s*"
    r"(?:(?P<const>\d+)|"
    r"\(\s*(?P<var>TMP|a|b)\s*(?P<op>[+-])\s*(?P<num>\d+)\s*\)"
    r"\s*mod\s*(?P<mod>\d+))"
)

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    target = match.group("target")
    if match.group("const") is not None:
        values[target] = int(match.group("const"))
    else:
        value = values[match.group("var")]
        delta = int(match.group("num"))
        if match.group("op") == "-":
            delta = -delta
        values[target] = (value + delta) % int(match.group("mod"))

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
